collection.description: A father notices that his baby is unusually warm and refuses a usual feed.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a father, notices that his baby is unusually warm and refuses a usual feed. He feels frightened but knows that acting promptly matters more than pretending to be calm.

choices.label: Bring the Baby to the Healer
Stay Awake to Monitor the Child

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer examines the child and begins appropriate care.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The baby needs close observation, and the father stays nearby.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They divide tasks and keep track of the baby's condition.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They disagree about what to do, then seek the healer's advice.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The baby rests more comfortably while care continues.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child remains unsettled, and he seeks further help.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: He notices a change and alerts the healer promptly.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Exhaustion catches up with him, and another adult takes a shift.
